snippet.title: 90s Extreme Skiing - Multiplayer Update Trailer - for PSVR2
snippet.description:
We’re excited to announce that online multiplayer is coming to 90s Extreme Skiing on PlayStation VR2 as a free update on Tuesday, July 8!

🚨 Multiplayer Features at Launch:
 -   4-player simultaneous racing
 -   Randomizable full-body avatars
 -   Triggerable ragdoll wipeouts for comedic effect
 -   Player knockouts via well-timed head punches
 -   Missed flags won’t disqualify you — they just add a time penalty

    💡 Please note: a PlayStation Plus subscription is required for online play.

📌 Additional Information:

  -  The update is free for all existing players, but the base game price will increase by approximately $2 one week after launch.

  -  Join us for a “Play with the Devs” session on Saturday, July 12, 2025, at 8pm CET / 2pm EDT / 11 am PDT!
    The game’s developers, PSN names grooviak and pike, will be hopping into random public lobbies for two hours!

[This trailer features some in-game footage kindly provided by YouTubers JammyHero and StockiVR - thanks, guys!]

#psvr2 #90sExtremeSkiing #vr
